title: Account for implementation weight
principle: Every visual choice has a cost in code, maintenance, and performance. Weigh delight against weight before committing.
procedure: For each fancy idea, estimate implementation weight (S/M/L) and maintenance.
Ask what lighter alternative preserves 80% of the feeling.
Prefer system primitives over one-off snowflakes when weight is high.
Document accepted weight so future you doesn’t ‘simplify’ blindly.
Cut ideas whose weight exceeds their contribution to the thesis.
